name: Grok 4.20
short: xAI's March/April 2026 reasoning flagship with a 2M window and a multi-agent mode (leader + 4 or 16 agents); SWE-bench 72-77% by harness, LiveCodeBench 84.3%, deprecated for Grok 4.3.
contextWindow: 1,000,000-2,000,000 (xAI docs 1M with 30K max output; OpenRouter, AA and BenchLM list 2M)
modalities: Text, image, file/PDF in; text out
pricingNote: xAI and OpenRouter: $1.25/$2.50 per 1M (<200K), $2.50/$5.00 above; $0.20 cached (not on OpenCode Zen)
standout: The multi-agent mode: a leader agent plus 4 or 16 parallel agents inside one call - a different reasoning shape for hard research and coding.
tradeoff: Multi-agent runs cost more per request and the line is deprecated; the trick survives only in spirit in later Groks.
